title: client_config.family
description: Family manager: present exactly when rules.family_manager.value is true (never on guests or devices with parental controls). children is the current scope as a short list for the tab “Family”; details come with family_get_children. remote: away = family functions also work away from home through Home Assistant and the integration relay (needs effective remote access), home_only = only in the home network. Changes of scope, children, notify settings or remote send client_config_updated.

notify.description: Automatic child notifications of this device (data/family.json notify_defaults; kids_release_requested always true).

notify_targets.description: Home Assistant notify services the admin linked to this family manager (requests arrive even with the app closed; actionable for mobile_app targets). Display only.
